value.rationale: Root population size and the number of singleton components are canonical macroscopic/microscopic observables in recursive-tree bond percolation and mutation models. Their separate exact marginals were known, but joint dependence is not characterized by them. The mixed-product cancellation gives the all-parameter negative covariance, its two-term fixed-p magnitude, fixed-p correlation constant, and distinct n/log n versus finite high-retention limits, making the cross-statistic useful beyond a routine finite computation.
